title: Keys2Balance Training Platform - Data Schemas Index
description: Root index file that references all entity schemas for the Keys2Balance training platform

users.description: Array of user accounts with roles and progress tracking

modules.description: Array of modules with various section types (video, zoom, materials, assessment)

assessments.description: Array of assessments with question groups and questions

discussions.description: Array of discussion threads for collaborative learning

homePage.description: Home page configuration including hero banner, instructor info, and announcements

platformSettings.description: Platform-level settings for branding and access control

info.description: This index file serves as the blueprint for the Keys2Balance training platform. Each entity type is defined in a separate schema file for better readability and maintainability.
info.schemaLocation: Each schema can be found in the same directory with its entity name (e.g., user.json, course.json, etc.)
info.usage:
Developers should use these schemas to:
- Design database schema
- Define backend API payloads
- Create frontend data models
- Validate data structures
- Maintain consistent data formats across the platform
